title: Exempt squash commit 5a73478 from the history check
summary: The history check fails on 5a73478 (squash of #14) because it changes records/ but names no job, intervention or record. The user approved exempting it, so I add its full id to [history].exempt in athena.toml with a comment explaining the cause.

defaults_applied.how: Recovered the precedent for exemptions from the existing [history] comments in athena.toml.
One-line config change plus a comment.
The comment explains the cause for an outside reader.
The exemption goes through the existing config list that the check enforces.

assumptions: The commit is reachable in the repository so its full id can be resolved with git.
The exemption is for this one commit only; the underlying check logic stays as is.
The existing rule that a commit adding an exempt entry must already have that commit in its history (D60) is satisfied, since 5a73478 is on main.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml [history].exempt gains the full 40-character id of the commit abbreviated 5a73478 (resolved with git log/show) and keeps the four existing entries.

A comment beside the entry says it is the squash of PR #14, that it changes records/ without naming a job, intervention or record, and that the exemption was approved by the user, following the #8/#9 precedent.
Run `git show --stat 5a73478` and confirm the id in athena.toml matches that commit in full.
Run `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`; all pass.
Among governance files only athena.toml changes, and records/ is untouched.

departures: Higher acceptance and pass odds and lower cost than the reference: the user confirmed the cause and the fix, and the change is one config entry with clear precedent.
